title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
brief: Investigate the folklore around the Fairies' Chapel in Healey Dell, clearly separating documented local history from stories about fairies, witches and the Fairy King.

title: Why does Rochdale say 'cruckle'?
brief: Explain the local dialect word 'cruckle', its meaning, how strongly it is associated with Rochdale and what dialect research can tell us about it.

title: Who or what is the Healey Dwarf?
brief: Explore the Healey Dell legend of the small ginger-bearded figure associated with the fairies, treating it explicitly as folklore and tracing the oldest reliable versions available.

title: Did Robin Hood really come to Healey Dell?
brief: Investigate the local Robin Hood, witches, magical ring and Fairy King stories connected with Healey Dell, separating legend from historical evidence.

title: The strange Healey Dell prophecy of a bride married and widowed in one day
brief: Trace the Eleanor Byron and Mother Bagden prophecy associated with Healey Dell, identify what is documented and label folklore as folklore.

title: Does a boggart still haunt Clegg Hall?
brief: Trace the old Clegg Hall tragedy and boggart tradition using historical folklore sources, distinguishing the legend from verifiable history.

title: The priest, the chicken and the shoe: Rochdale's strangest boggart story
brief: Retell and investigate the old Clegg Hall tale in which a priest answers a spirit demanding a body and soul with a cock's body and a shoe sole. Treat it as folklore.

title: Did goblins move Rochdale Parish Church up the hill?
brief: Investigate the tradition that supernatural creatures repeatedly moved building stones for St Chad's uphill overnight, and explain the real history of the church site.

title: The ghost rabbit that once terrified Rochdale
brief: Research the Baum Rabbit folklore around St Mary in the Baum, including early recorded accounts and how Rochdale families used the story. Treat supernatural claims as folklore.

title: Is there really a secret tunnel underneath Middleton?
brief: Investigate the alleged passage between the Ring O' Bells and Middleton Parish Church, including Civil War traditions and whether physical or documentary evidence exists.

title: Who is the sad Cavalier said to haunt Middleton?
brief: Explore the Ring O' Bells ghost tradition involving a Royalist often called Edward, while separating venue folklore from documented Civil War history.

title: Is Rochdale Town Hall haunted?
brief: Investigate ghost stories, paranormal events and historical incidents associated with Rochdale Town Hall. Do not present supernatural claims as established fact.

title: Rochdale's own Stonehenge? The mysterious stones found on the moors
brief: Explain archaeological discoveries of stone settings and possible prehistoric burial sites on the moors around Rochdale, using archaeological or council sources and avoiding exaggerated certainty.

title: There used to be a castle in Castleton — so where did it go?
brief: Tell the story of Rochdale Castle at Castleton, what historians know of it, when it disappeared and what survives beneath or around the modern landscape.

title: Is the ancient road over Blackstone Edge really Roman?
brief: Explain the long-running argument over the origins of the paved route across Blackstone Edge and what archaeology says about Roman, medieval and later use.

title: Did stone from Healey Dell really end up in Trafalgar Square?
brief: Investigate the local claim that Healey Dell stone was used in Trafalgar Square, looking for quarry, construction or heritage evidence and clearly labelling any unresolved legend.

title: The Rochdale Town Hall toilet built for Queen Victoria that she never used
brief: Research the story of the special Town Hall toilet associated with Queen Victoria, why it was prepared and what actually happened on her planned or expected visit.

title: The day Rochdale Council hired a deep-sea diver
brief: Tell the documented 1927 story of a deep-sea diver being used to repair a large gas holder in Rochdale and explain why such an unusual solution was needed.

title: When Buffalo Bill brought the Wild West to Rochdale
brief: Research Buffalo Bill's Wild West show visit to Rochdale in 1904, including venue, programme and contemporary evidence where available.

title: The day Rochdale cooked the world's biggest pancake
brief: Revisit the Co-operative movement's giant pancake world record in Rochdale in 1994, including its dimensions, purpose and whether the record still stands.

title: What does Concorde have to do with Littleborough?
brief: Explain the Littleborough textile or loom technology adapted to make fibreglass moulds associated with Concorde nose-cone production, verifying the engineering history carefully.

title: The supermarket technology tested in Castleton before the rest of Britain got it
brief: Research the claim that early automatic supermarket tills were tested in Castleton in the early 1980s and explain what made the trial significant.

title: Was the world's first railway tunnel built in Rochdale?
brief: Investigate the claim associated with the early railway tunnel at Healey Dell, explain the railway's history and compare the wording of the record claim with other early tunnels.

title: How Rochdale once ended up with the world's widest bridge
brief: Explain how covering the River Roch created the structure described as the world's widest bridge, and what changed when the river was reopened.

title: The Rochdale man who became one of Britain's most notorious hangmen
brief: Profile executioner John Ellis, born in the Rochdale area, using reputable historical sources and treating executions factually rather than sensationally.

title: Did Dick Turpin really drink in Middleton?
brief: Investigate traditions linking Dick Turpin and Bonny Prince Charlie to the Olde Boar's Head, distinguishing old inn folklore from documented visits.

title: The story of Cowm Park Reservoir
brief: Tell the history of Cowm Park Reservoir: why it was created, how the landscape changed, its later recreational use and notable local memories.

title: How Healey Dell became one of Rochdale's most remarkable landscapes
brief: Explain the natural, industrial and railway history of Healey Dell, including the gorge, mills, viaduct and nature reserve.

title: The history hidden inside Queen's Park in Heywood
brief: Tell the history of Queen's Park in Heywood, including its opening, design, notable structures, changes over time and local significance.

title: Did Hitler really want to spare Rochdale Town Hall?
brief: Investigate the local story that Hitler wanted Rochdale Town Hall preserved or moved to Germany. Treat it as a myth-versus-evidence investigation and do not assert the claim without documentary proof.

title: What life was really like in Rochdale during the Second World War
brief: Research wartime Rochdale: air raids, civil defence, local industry, rationing, women at work, servicemen and surviving physical traces.

title: The famous people Rochdale gave the world
brief: Create a carefully checked feature on notable people born in Rochdale borough, distinguishing people born locally from those who only lived, studied or worked here.

title: How high is unemployment in Rochdale right now?
brief: Use the newest available ONS or official labour-market data to explain Rochdale's unemployment or claimant picture and compare it fairly with Greater Manchester and Britain. State the data period prominently.

title: What does the average worker in Rochdale actually earn?
brief: Use the newest available ONS earnings data to explain typical pay in Rochdale, preferring median earnings over a misleading simple average and stating whether figures refer to residents or workplaces.

title: What Ofsted has been saying about Rochdale schools
brief: Use current Ofsted inspection reports to produce a factual roundup of recently inspected Rochdale borough schools. Quote sparingly, link to official reports and make inspection dates and grades clear.

title: The major new housing developments coming to Rochdale borough
brief: Use current council planning records and developer information to identify substantial residential schemes approved, under construction or proposed across the borough, clearly distinguishing planning status.

title: The shops, warehouses and workplaces coming next to Rochdale borough
brief: Use current planning records and primary sources to identify significant commercial developments coming to the borough and explain their stage, scale and likely use.

title: Cyril Smith: what official investigations established and how victims were failed
brief: A rigorous historical accountability feature on the late Cyril Smith and child sexual abuse allegations and findings. Rely primarily on official inquiries, police or parliamentary records; attribute claims precisely; explain institutional failures; avoid sensational language and protect victims' identities.
